publication.title: [v0.93.1][compiler] Enforce limits before semantic validation
publication.body:
Enforce compiler resource budgets before semantic validation traverses typed inputs or workflow graphs, and make dependency-cycle validation iterative. Add focused regressions for deep typed input, unselected declarations, and long dependency chains.

Closes #1289
